description: Admin store approval + app management. New vendor_approval_status enum + vendors.approval_status (default pending, existing rows backfilled approved) + dedicated vendors.gcash_number/gcash_name columns in migration 0008, with the guard_vendor_columns admin-only status rule and the student-facing RLS narrowing. Frontend: map the columns + derive publicVendors in VendorContext, switch Home/Search/VendorStore to publicVendors (non-approved not orderable), extend Admin.jsx Vendors panel with approve/reject/suspend/re-activate, and gate the Dashboard pre-order Switch on approval + gcash_number while adding the GCash fields to the store editor. Independent of FEAT-002; FEAT-003 reuses the gcash_number/gcash_name columns this feature adds, so this runs first. Corresponds to plan.md items 1-5.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/0008_vendor_approval.sql: create enum public.vendor_approval_status ('pending','approved','rejected','suspended') with the do-$$-if-not-exists block mirroring 0002_enums.sql; add vendors.approval_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'; backfill `update public.vendors set approval_status='approved' where approval_status='pending'`; add vendors_approval_status_idx; add nullable vendors.gcash_number and vendors.gcash_name; `create or replace function public.guard_vendor_columns()` re-declaring the WHOLE 0004 body and adding a branch that raises when approval_status changes and public.auth_role()<>'admin' (keep service-role early return, foodherons.rating_sync flag, rating/review_count, and owner_id guards); drop policy vendors_select_all and create vendors_select_approved_or_privileged (approval_status='approved' or owner_id=auth.uid() or public.auth_role()='admin').

VendorContext.jsx: in mapVendor add approvalStatus/gcashNumber/gcashName; in updateVendorInfo add gcash_number/gcash_name patch lines (mirror phone); add derived publicVendors = vendors.filter(v => v.approvalStatus==='approved') to the memo + context value; keep getVendor and currentVendorId bound to the FULL vendors list (pinned invariant — do NOT switch getVendor to publicVendors).

Home.jsx: swap vendors -> publicVendors in the directory VendorResults list, categoryVendors, openCount, and hero stats count. Search.jsx: swap vendors -> publicVendors in results and popular. VendorStore.jsx: keep getVendor(id); when the resolved store's approvalStatus !== 'approved', force canOrder=false and show the existing store-note message ('This vendor isn't available right now.').

Admin.jsx: add an approval status filter chip row to the Vendors panel (All/Pending/Approved/Rejected/Suspended reusing .chip/.admin-tab); in VendorRow add a status badge (pending->badge--preorder, approved->badge--open, rejected/suspended->badge--closed) and status-dependent buttons calling the existing run(() => supabase.from('vendors').update({ approval_status:'<next>' }).eq('id', vendor.id)): pending->Approve/Reject, approved->Suspend, rejected/suspended->Re-activate(approved); optionally a pending count badge on the Vendors tab. Add matching status styles in Admin.css using existing orange/yellow tokens (no blue).

Dashboard.jsx: when vendor.approvalStatus !== 'approved' render a dashboard-empty banner (awaiting approval/suspended) and disable the pre-order Switch so setPreorder(true) cannot fire; when !vendor.gcashNumber disable the Switch with the hint 'Add your GCash number in Store info to enable pre-ordering' (thread disabled/hint through TopBar to Switch). In ProfileTab add gcashNumber/gcashName inputs next to phone (reuse dashboard-field/dashboard-input), add their keys to FORM_KEYS, and include them in the profile memo so updateVendorInfo persists them.
acceptance_criteria: 0008_vendor_approval.sql follows the 0002 enum idempotency and 0004 guard patterns; it does not edit any applied migration.
`npm install` then `npm run build` succeeds with the VendorContext/Home/Search/VendorStore/Admin/Dashboard changes.
A non-approved store is excluded from publicVendors (directory/search) and its store page is not orderable; getVendor still resolves it for owner/order paths.
The Admin Vendors panel renders approve/reject/suspend/re-activate controls appropriate to each status and writes approval_status via the existing admin RLS UPDATE path.
The Dashboard pre-order Switch is disabled (with the stated hint/banner) while the store is not approved or has no gcash_number; the GCash fields persist via updateVendorInfo.
No blue is introduced; new badges/styles use existing orange/yellow tokens.
verification: cd c:\Users\paulc\Projects\FoodHerons\.worktrees\new-features; npm install (first run) then npm run build — succeeds.
Review 0008_vendor_approval.sql against 0002/0004/0005 for enum idempotency, the preserved guard branches, and the replaced SELECT policy.
dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln still succeeds (this feature touches no C#, so the build must remain green).
findings:
GCASH COLUMNS (FEAT-003 reuses these): added to public.vendors in 0008_vendor_approval.sql as `gcash_number text` and `gcash_name text` — both NULLABLE, no default, existing/demo rows keep NULL. Mapped in VendorContext.mapVendor as `gcashNumber: r.gcash_number` / `gcashName: r.gcash_name`; persisted via updateVendorInfo patch lines `patch.gcash_number = info.gcashNumber` / `patch.gcash_name = info.gcashName` (owner-editable, NOT admin-gated). The student payment step must read `vendor.gcashName`/`vendor.gcashNumber` via getVendor(order.vendorId) (FULL list), NOT `phone`.

APPROVAL: enum public.vendor_approval_status ('pending','approved','rejected','suspended'); column vendors.approval_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', existing rows backfilled to 'approved'; index vendors_approval_status_idx. guard_vendor_columns() re-declared in 0008 with ALL 0004 branches preserved (service-role early return, foodherons.rating_sync flag, rating/review_count, owner_id) plus a new admin-only approval_status branch. Policy vendors_select_all DROPPED and replaced by vendors_select_approved_or_privileged (approval_status='approved' or owner_id=auth.uid() or auth_role()='admin').

FRONTEND: VendorContext now exports `publicVendors` (vendors.filter approvalStatus==='approved'); getVendor/currentVendorId stay bound to the FULL vendors list (PINNED invariant — do not switch to publicVendors). Home/Search consume publicVendors; VendorStore forces canOrder=false + shows store-note when approvalStatus!=='approved'. Admin Vendors panel has an approval filter chip row + per-row status badge + Approve/Reject/Suspend/Re-activate buttons (admin RLS UPDATE path). Dashboard gates the pre-order Switch via `preorderLock` ({disabled,hint}) threaded TopBar->Switch, shows a dashboard-empty--banner while not approved, and has GCash fields in ProfileTab (FORM_KEYS + profile memo include gcashNumber/gcashName).

MIGRATION ORDER: 0008 depends on 0004+0005 applied. 0009/0010 (FEAT-003) still follow 0008. No C# touched; dotnet build stays green. Verified: npm install + npm run build OK, dotnet build server/FoodHerons.sln OK.
